_comment: Critic Feedback Test 3: Feedback + Suspend coexistence — Verifica que '=== PREVIOUS ATTEMPT — WHY IT FAILED ===' y '=== USER CLARIFICATION ===' coexisten en el mismo prompt cuando el Critic rechaza primero y luego suspende.
_test_instructions: ESPERADO: Critic rechaza (task_ok=false, feedback sobre los 3 elementos faltantes).
En el segundo intento el agente recibe '=== PREVIOUS ATTEMPT — WHY IT FAILED ===' con el feedback.
Si el agente no mejora suficiente, el Critic suspende con pregunta sobre budget vs luxury.
PASO 2 — Si suspende con pregunta sobre budget vs luxury:
--answer 'Focus on budget travelers, daily budget around 80-100 USD'
ESPERADO: El siguiente prompt del agente contiene AMBAS secciones:
- '=== USER CLARIFICATION ===' con la respuesta del usuario
- '=== PREVIOUS ATTEMPT — WHY IT FAILED ===' con el último feedback del Critic
El Critic aprueba y el grafo termina con FINISHED.
1. Intento 1 → Critic rechaza (task_ok=false, feedback sobre los 3 elementos faltantes)
2. Intento 2 → agente recibe '=== PREVIOUS ATTEMPT — WHY IT FAILED ===' → puede mejorar o no
3. Si no mejora suficiente → Critic suspende con pregunta al usuario
4. Usuario responde → agente recibe '=== USER CLARIFICATION ===' + '=== PREVIOUS ATTEMPT — WHY IT FAILED ==='

config.prompt: Write a travel guide for Tokyo.

planner.system_message: Create exactly ONE task: assign 'Write a travel guide for Tokyo' to travel_agent in phase 1. Output ONLY a JSON array with one item.

travel_agent.description: Writes a travel guide for a given destination.

config.system_message: You are a travel writer. Write a brief travel guide for Tokyo in 4-5 sentences. Do not ask about traveler preferences unless specifically instructed.

critic.system_message:
You are a travel guide critic. Follow these rules in order:

RULE 1 — First review (no USER CLARIFICATION section present in the agent output being reviewed):
  Always reject the first attempt. Set task_ok=false, suspend=false.
  feedback="Your guide must include: (1) the best time of year to visit Tokyo in months, (2) at least one specific neighborhood name, (3) estimated daily budget in USD. Add these to your next attempt."

RULE 2 — Second review (USER CLARIFICATION section IS present in the agent output being reviewed):
  Set task_ok=true, feedback="". Approve regardless of content.

RULE 3 — If the guide includes all three elements from RULE 1 (months, neighborhood, USD budget):
  Set task_ok=true, feedback="".

Use suspend=true ONLY if you need to ask the user something before continuing.
For this test: after the first rejection, if the agent still does not include the required elements, set suspend=true with question="The travel agent needs guidance: should the guide focus on budget travelers or luxury travelers? This will determine the recommended budget range."

phase_reactor.system_message: Review the phase results. If the travel guide task is complete, set requires_replanning=false.

final_reactor.system_message: Summarize the final travel guide outcome in 2-3 lines.
